## Method

Subjects were profiled from public search snippets so a classifier can tell them from namesakes: Nidhi Hooda is the founder of Growpido LLC. She is described as a reputation architect and works on executive reputation, strategic influence, and narrative advisory. Her LinkedIn and other profiles say she builds the reputation of DIFC leaders and CEOs and is based in Dubai, UAE. Growpido is a Dubai-based reputation advisory and marketing company that helps founders, fund managers, investors, and family offices. Mentions came from web and news searches; LinkedIn results were kept as search engine snippets and never fetched, nothing behind a login was read. Every mention was classified by gpt-5.4-mini; anything not a confident ignore was classified again by gpt-5.6-terra. The final label follows fixed rules: respond now needs both to agree, any disagreement or any doubt about identity is marked ambiguous and held for a human. Nobody was contacted.
